data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter logger with configurable levels, build‑mode control and custom printer.
data.what_it_does: EasyLogger lets you log messages with optional levels and stack traces. You can enable or disable logging per Flutter build mode and customize the output printer. It provides helper methods like debug, info, warning, and error.
use_when: You need quick, in‑app logging without external services
You want to control logging per build mode (debug/profile/release)
avoid_when: You require structured or remote logging (e.g., to Sentry)
You need log persistence to files or databases
You need advanced formatting or log aggregation
strengths: Very easy to add and configure
Fine‑grained control over build modes and levels
Custom printer allows any output format
weaknesses: No built‑in support for file or network sinks
Limited formatting and no structured logging

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar simple logging with pretty output and optional file sinks

alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers richer log formatting and integrates with the Talker ecosystem
